snippet.title: Rottenroots - Announcement Trailer | STEAM
snippet.description:
In this immersive visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty in a dangerous solarpunk dystopia. Every decision shapes not just the story, but Salem's very identity.

A DEEPLY PERSONAL ROLEPLAYING EXPERIENCE
Your choices forge more than just the story—they forge who Salem becomes. Will you remain loyal to the regime or follow your heart? With multiple unique endings waiting to be discovered, your Salem could become a hero, villain, or something far more complex.

DYNAMIC CHARACTER RELATIONSHIPS
Characters remember your actions and evolve alongside your choices. Show unexpected kindness, and enemies might become allies. Your relationships transform with each playthrough, creating a truly personalized experience every time.

TENSE DECISIONS UNDER PRESSURE
When the clock starts ticking, your instincts reveal who you truly are. Face moments where hesitation means death, and split-second choices determine who lives and who dies.

A HAUNTINGLY BEAUTIFUL DYSTOPIA
Experience a world where technology and nature intertwine, and resistance blooms in unexpected places. In a society where conformity means survival, every secret harbored is another root growing deeper.

Features:

-A unique personality system where your choices shape character traits
-Multiple endings ranging from heart-wrenching tragedy to bittersweet triumph
-Stunning hand-drawn visuals by Laura Meggers (@meggerzine)
-Atmospheric soundtrack that enhances the emotional journey
-Timed decisions that test your moral compass

Release Date: Coming Soon
Platforms: PC via Steam
Developer: Klabautermann Games

Wishlist Rottenroots on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/
